dialogData.DialogContent: My dearest person in the world…
We’ve been married 48 hours and we still don't have a 20-year plan!
Let's start from here, what are we going to call our first-born?
It needs to be strong, timeless, and noble.
It has to be unique!
You listening…?
Talking about the baby…
How are we going to manage a mortgage?
When do you think the economy will be better?
Will there be WWIII?
(She is in that mood again…)
And the most importantly…
What do you want for dinner?
What?
What do you want for dinner honey?
Wow finally a question I can answer.
We have not been to this restaurant for so long.
Last time we were here was university time.
Time flies, at that time you even don't know how to talk to a girl.
Shut up…
Talking about this…
Could you tell me your favorite, most super-special memory of our early dating days.
Please? With a cherry on top?
